map.不应直接采用。封顶方案只是数学上的等分结果，实际还需考虑剂型规格（如片剂不可分割: Do not apply it directly. The capped plan is only a mathematical equal-split result; in practice you must also consider the dosage form (a tablet, for example, cannot be split), the indication, liver and kidney function and concomitant drugs. Exceeding the cap means the chosen dose strength or interval is unsafe for that body weight; the correct move is to go back to the label or the medical order and pick a different dose strength or interval rather than dosing mechanically at the capped value.
map.为什么儿童按体重算、成人却用固定的日上限？: Why do children dose by body weight while adults use a fixed daily cap?
map.儿科门诊按体重（mg/kg）计算单次剂量与每日总量，并自动与儿童最大日剂量（按体: The paediatric clinic computes the single dose and the daily total by body weight (mg/kg), and automatically compares against the maximum daily paediatric dose (converted by body weight) to avoid overdosing.
map.儿童肝肾功能与体表面积随体重变化大，剂量几乎都按 mg/kg/日 折算并再设体重: Paediatric liver and kidney function and body surface area change greatly with weight, so doses are almost always converted by mg/kg/day and then capped by body weight; adult organ function is stable, so labels usually give an absolute daily cap directly (for example paracetamol 4000 mg/day, ibuprofen 2400 mg/day). The tool switches at age >=14, but anyone whose physique deviates markedly from their age group should still be dosed by actual weight or body surface area.
map.切换给药间隔（q4h/q6h/q8h/q12h/q24h）后观察每日总量变化，判: After switching the dosing interval (q4h/q6h/q8h/q12h/q24h), watch how the daily total changes to see whether a regimen would breach the daily dose cap.
map.在剂量强度（下限/中位/上限）之间切换，评估「取上限」时的安全性边界，超限则由工: Switch between dose strengths (low / medium / high) to assess the safety margin when taking the upper end; if the cap is exceeded the tool gives a corrected plan after capping.
map.工具提示超限后，我该直接采用它给的封顶方案吗？: When the tool warns that a limit is exceeded, should I just use the capped plan it gives?
map.用药剂量计算器（按体重kg） 使用指南: How to use the medication dose calculator (by body weight kg)
map.选择药物并输入体重，自动按 mg/kg 计算单次剂量、每日总量及最大日剂量校验。: Select the drug and enter the weight to automatically compute the single dose and the daily total in mg/kg and check them against the maximum daily dose.
map.：单次剂量 = 每公斤剂量(mg/kg) × 体重(kg)；每日次数 = rou: : single dose = dose per kg (mg/kg) x weight (kg); doses per day = round(24 / dosing interval in hours); daily total = single dose x number of doses; the maximum paediatric daily dose = per-kg daily cap (mg/kg) x weight, while adults (>=14 years) use the label adult daily cap. If the daily total exceeds the maximum daily dose, the tool warns and gives a capped plan: capped daily dose = maximum daily dose, capped single dose = capped daily dose / number of doses.
map.：对乙酰氨基酚、20 kg 儿童、中位剂量（12.5 mg/kg）、q6h：次数: : paracetamol, 20 kg child, median dose (12.5 mg/kg), q6h: number of doses = 24/6 = 4; single dose = 12.5 x 20 = 250.0 mg; daily total = 1000.0 mg; the paediatric cap = 60 x 20 = 1200.0 mg -> not over the limit, regimen 250 mg q6h. By comparison amoxicillin, 20 kg, cap dose (40 mg/kg), q8h: number of doses = 3; single dose = 800.0 mg; daily total = 2400.0 mg > the 1800.0 mg cap -> over the limit, and the tool gives a corrected regimen of 600.0 mg q8h (1800.0 mg/day in total). Ibuprofen, 20 kg, median (7.5 mg/kg), q8h: single dose 150.0 mg, daily 450.0 mg, cap 800.0 mg -> safe.
